title: Mr. Kayashima's Life of Luxury
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sumito Kayashima, a wealthy, solitary man from an old family, suddenly visits his gardener's home and confesses his love. Angered by this high-handed courtship, the gardener makes a cruel demand of him. Across three volumes (adapted from a novel by Haruhi Tono), the master and gardener build a secret relationship across the social gap, including a trip to England.
life_message: Love requires the powerful to learn humility and see the other person as an equal.
